title: Page 208
transc:
Ft Monroe June 16 / 64
Maj. Eckert 
Washington
Add following to Brutus from insanity black gallant
Hancock is not near enough to render nankin
any aid zebra the garden papers have nothing
to indicate a suspicion of our planning the
Bergen zodiac They expect toby oiled saxon direction
of Malvern hill yoke Day lea received clara ,
Geo. D. Sheldon


Fortress Monroe June 16 / 64
Maj. Eckert Washington
Snake Randolph panther appian francis gas for
Pandora W. H. Pettus pontiac Raymond queenly 
navy yard growl White Hows is nursed
zebra send material here walrus Channing Clapp
A. A Shelby All well nothing new
Geo. D. Sheldon


1 P. M.
Fortress Monroe June 17 / 64 
Maj. Eckert Washington
Pilgrim of boat that brought down to
James town sidney insanity's dispatch says that
all the whiskey have plumed and that
village patron is probably by this time
taken up yoke Day lea nothing later
Geo. D. Sheldon
